comment: Bridge configs (modbus-bridge): a version 2 config with a 'bridge' object, as canworks-bridge loads it ("host": "bridge"). The plugin's unit tests and the deploy tool's tests/test_contract.py run each case; both must reach the verdict with the messages.

cases.name: bridge: the base config
bridge: a double word at an odd byte
messages: %ID1 must start at an even byte: word locations are whole Modbus registers

cases.name: bridge: a bit inside a double word
messages: status_location (%IX2.0) and
(%ID0) overlap in input byte 2

cases.name: bridge: a byte inside a double word
messages: master state_location (%IB3) and
(%ID0) overlap in input byte 3

cases.name: bridge: a block sharing two bytes with a double word
messages: (%ID0) and bridge status_location (%IB2) overlap in input bytes 2 and 3

cases.name: bridge: bits of one byte with different bit numbers
bridge: two locations on the same bit
messages: both map to %IX16.0

cases.name: bridge: inputs and outputs at the same byte do not clash
bridge: the status block over a location
messages: and bridge status_location (%IB18) overlap in input byte 20

cases.name: bridge: the control block in the inputs
messages: control_location must be an output byte location (%QB...) where its 6-byte block starts, not %IB8

cases.name: bridge: the status block as a word
messages: status_location must be an input byte location (%IB...) where its 8-byte block starts, not %IW24

cases.name: bridge: a block past the image
messages: status_location %IB8190: its 8-byte block ends outside the image (8192 bytes)

cases.name: bridge: listen with a host name
messages: field 'listen' must be address:port with a numeric address, such as 0.0.0.0:502 or [::]:502, not "localhost:502"

cases.name: bridge: listen without a port
messages: field 'listen' must be address:port

cases.name: bridge: listen on IPv6
bridge: listen missing
messages: bridge: missing required field 'listen'

cases.name: bridge: unknown word order
messages: field 'word_order' must be "high_first" or "low_first"

cases.name: bridge: low word first
bridge: no clients
messages: field 'max_clients' must be 1-64

cases.name: bridge: too many clients
messages: field 'max_clients' is out of range (max 64): 65

cases.name: bridge: unit ID too large
messages: field 'unit_id' is out of range (max 255): 256

cases.name: bridge: watchdog too long
messages: field 'watchdog_ms' is out of range (max 60000): 60001

cases.name: bridge: unknown client-loss action
messages: field 'on_client_loss' must be "stop", "zero", "hold", "preop" or "safe"

cases.name: bridge: zero on client loss
bridge: allowlists
bridge: a prefix too long
messages: field 'writers': "10.0.0.0/33" is not an IPv4 or IPv6 address or prefix

cases.name: bridge: a host name in the readers
messages: field 'readers': "plc.local" is not an IPv4 or IPv6 address or prefix

cases.name: bridge: a live list of an unknown network
messages: bridge.live_lists[0]: network "nope" is not in the config

cases.name: bridge: a live list without a location
messages: bridge.live_lists[0]: missing required field 'location'

cases.name: bridge: SDO bridge without a response block
messages: bridge.sdo_bridge_location: missing required field 'response'

cases.name: bridge: SDO writes without the SDO bridge
bridge: the SDO bridge blocks overlap the control block
messages: bridge control_location (%QB8) and bridge sdo_bridge_location.request (%QB10) overlap in output bytes 10 and 11 and 12 and 13

cases.name: bridge: an unknown field
bridge: not an object
messages: field 'bridge' must be an object

cases.name: bridge: SYNC from the PLC cycle
messages: "sync_source": "plc_cycle" needs a PLC cycle, which the Modbus bridge does not have

cases.name: bridge: no blocks at all
bridge: writers missing
messages: bridge: missing required field 'writers': list the addresses that may write, or ["0.0.0.0/0", "::/0"] to let every address write

cases.name: bridge: nobody writes
bridge: every address writes
bridge: clients per address
bridge: no clients per address
messages: bridge: field 'max_clients_per_address' must be 1-64

cases.name: bridge: too many clients per address
messages: bridge: field 'max_clients_per_address' is out of range (max 64): 65

cases.name: bridge: a block at the top of the 32-bit range
messages: status_location %IB4294967295 lies outside the runtime I/O image (index must be below 8192)

cases.name: bridge: a location that wraps the 32-bit range
messages: %ID4294967294 lies outside the runtime I/O image (index must be below 8192)

cases.name: bridge: a raw location past the image
messages: networks[0].raw.rx[0].data_location: %IL8188 lies outside the runtime I/O image (index must be below 8192)

cases.name: bridge: J1939 trouble codes 4 bytes apart
bridge: J1939 trouble codes next to a byte input
messages: diagnostics rx[0] code 2

cases.name: bit channels on the bridge name bits of the entry's own location
TPDO bit channels on the bridge
bit channel with a location on the bridge
messages: node 2 (pingpong), object 0x4001:0 bit 3: a bit has no iec_location in a bridge config

cases.name: bridge: mailboxes with the default counts
bridge: every mailbox count at its maximum
bridge: two receive mailbox blocks
bridge: three receive mailbox blocks
messages: bridge.mailboxes: field 'receive_blocks' must be 1 or 2: 3

cases.name: bridge: no receive mailbox block
messages: bridge.mailboxes: field 'receive_blocks' must be 1 or 2: 0

cases.name: bridge: mailboxes without an output location
messages: bridge.mailboxes: missing required field 'output_location' (where the mailbox area starts; Pack for Modbus in the configurator sets it)

cases.name: bridge: a mailbox area at an odd byte
messages: bridge.mailboxes: %IB65: a mailbox area starts at an even byte (a register)

cases.name: bridge: a mailbox over the SDO bridge response
messages: bridge sdo_bridge_location.response (%IB48) and bridge mailbox 0 response (%IB60) overlap in input bytes 60 and 61

cases.name: bridge: too many request mailboxes
messages: bridge.mailboxes: field 'requests' is out of range (max 4): 5

cases.name: bridge: the receive mailbox as a number
messages: bridge.mailboxes: field 'receive' must be true or false

cases.name: bridge: a mailbox area past the image
bridge: an unknown mailbox field
bridge entry with bits and no location
messages: node 2 (pingpong), object 0x4001:0: the bridge serves an entry's bits in its own location

cases.name: bridge: the PLC link without openplc keeps its blocks in place
messages: field 'status_location' must be %IB4 with 'plc_link' (input bytes 0-3 hold the map hash), or left out
bridge map hash (PLC link) (%IB0) overlap in input bytes 0 and 1 and 2 and 3
the PLC link header (output bytes 0-5) (%QB0) overlap in output bytes 0 and 1 and 2 and 3

cases.name: bridge: the removed openplc field
messages: field 'openplc' was removed: OpenPLC is a connection on the Modbus bridge page; open the config in the configurator and add it there

cases.name: bridge: connections must be a list
messages: field 'connections' must be a list

cases.name: bridge: safe values
bridge: safe action without safe values
bridge: a safe value out of range
messages: bridge.safe_values: %QD0 (networks[0] (io) node 2 (pingpong) RPDO 1 object 0x4000:0): -1 is out of range 0-4294967295

cases.name: bridge: a safe value as a decimal string
bridge: a safe value that is not a number
messages: bridge.safe_values: %QD0 (networks[0] (io) node 2 (pingpong) RPDO 1 object 0x4000:0) is an integer: its safe value must be a whole number (a decimal string beyond 2^53), in 0-4294967295

cases.name: bridge: a safe value on the control block
messages: bridge.safe_values: %QB8 is the bridge's own block (bridge control_location): safe values cannot be set on the bridge's own block

cases.name: bridge: a safe value with nothing bound
messages: bridge.safe_values: %QW4 has no output bound to it; safe values go on RPDO entries and J1939 or raw transmit signals

cases.name: bridge: a safe value on an input
messages: bridge.safe_values: %ID0 is an input location; safe values are for outputs (%Q)

cases.name: bridge: a bit's safe value
messages: bridge.safe_values: %QX3.0 (networks[0] (io) node 2 (pingpong) RPDO 1 object 0x4000:0) is a bit: its safe value must be true, false, 0 or 1

cases.name: bridge: a safe value on an NMT command byte
messages: bridge.safe_values: %QB4 is an NMT command byte (networks[0] (io) node 2 (pingpong) nmt_command_location): safe values cannot be set on an NMT command byte

cases.name: bridge: safe values not used
warnings: bridge: 'safe_values' are used only with "on_client_loss": "safe"; they are not used now

cases.name: bridge: safe values not an object
messages: bridge: field 'safe_values' must be an object from %Q locations to values

cases.name: bridge: plc_link not a boolean
messages: field 'plc_link' must be true or false
